messages:
maria.a: Quick sales->CS transfer for Kestrel Dynamics. Contract live 2026-04-01. PO KD-9921 uploaded to sales drive. Oliver Chen is primary (oliver.chen@kestrel.ai).

maria.a: Customer needs Private VPC in eu-west-1, SAML SSO, Dedicated capacity (initial target ~200 req/s peak). Expected early traffic ~15-25 rps. Legal added DPA + EU residency clause.

sam.k: Assigning CS lead and onboarding PM. I'll be CS lead for first 8 weeks.

sam.k: Devin, can you run onboarding PM and own the kickoff + artifact collection?

devin.p: I can. Need IdP metadata, network diagram, list of allowed IPs, and customer infra contact. Also confirm envs: prod + staging?

maria.a: Oliver confirmed prod+staging. He'll share IdP metadata and network diagram by EOD tomorrow.

nina.se: Tech flags: provisioning for Private + Dedicated GPUs ~2-3 weeks after network + billing clear. SAML attrs: email and groups. Create ENGINF ticket for firewall/routing. Also note: requested model opt-7b-quant needs quant validation on Dedicated infra.

lee.support: I'll draft the customer runbook (incidents, SLAs, escalation ladder) and a first-30-day checklist. Who is our 24/7 escalation POC?

sam.k: L2: lee.support, L3/Eng: nina.se, CS owner: sam.k.

devin.p: Kickoff checklist (short):
- Kickoff meeting (60m) 126-04-06 10:00 CET proposed
- IdP metadata + test account
- Network diagram + firewall rules
- Provision Dedicated nodes (recommend 2x A100)
- Deploy staging; perf smoke + quant validation
- SSO test + enablement session
- Publish runbook in secure share

ops-bot: calendar-bot: Meeting created: "Kestrel Dynamics 126 Onboarding Kickoff" Tue 2026-04-06 10:00 CET. Guests: maria.a, sam.k, devin.p, nina.se, lee.support, oliver.chen@kestrel.ai

devin.p: I'll make secure folder and invite team + Oliver. Opening provisioning ticket PROV-76021 and ENGINF-4821 for routing.

nina.se: Please post network artifacts to secure share (do not put IPs in Slack). Retention note: customer requested 1yr logs; legal approved, will include in deployment spec and IAM mapping.

lee.support: Monitoring to configure: token error spikes, latency >500ms, 5xx >0.5% — will prep dashboards and alerting rules before go-live. Also add feedback form link to enablement agenda.

maria.a: Billing: committed monthly rate, 12-month term. Upsell: propose 6-month perf review to discuss expansion.

sam.k: Risk tracker: missing IdP or network docs will delay provisioning. Perf validation may require larger capacity or different quant profile. I'll monitor weekly.

devin.p: Action owners: maria.a (PO/legal notes), oliver.chen (IdP + network diagram), devin.p (secure folder + kickoff agenda), nina.se (ENGINF + perf plan), lee.support (runbook + monitoring), sam.k (weekly check-ins).

maria.a: Customer asked about locked-down read-only eval for security team. Nina, can staging be read-only?

nina.se: Yes. Staging can be ACL-locked for read-only evaluators; need list of emails.

devin.p: I'll collect evaluator emails and upload them.

sam.k: Thanks all. I'll post status updates in the tracker after kickoff. Please tick off tasks as done. :thumbsup:
